# Nataka Inc

> Nataka Inc is a media and marketing agency in Nairobi, Kenya. Services include brand promotion, brand strategy, digital marketing, brand films, corporate video, social content and creator campaigns for businesses in Kenya.

Contact: WhatsApp / phone +254 117 386 206 · andrew@natakainc.com · https://www.natakainc.com/#contact

## Services
- [Brand Promotion in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/brand-promotion-kenya): Campaign strategy, brand films, social content and rollout.
- [Social Media Marketing in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/social-media-marketing-kenya)
- [Corporate Video Production in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/corporate-video-production-kenya)
- [Product Launch Video in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/product-launch-video-kenya)
- [AI Video Production in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/ai-video-production-kenya): AI commercials, music videos, consistent AI characters and effects on real footage. Case study: AANOTHER, a fictional arena rock band made entirely with AI by Nataka (3 music videos, 650+ finished AI shots, same four characters in every frame).
- [The Nataka AI Standard](https://www.natakainc.com/ai-standard): seven published rules for every Nataka AI production: written consent before any likeness, AI labels, a human director on every frame, frame-by-frame checks, no fake customers or engagement, no political deepfakes, and disclosure of the AI tools used.
- [Video Production in Nairobi](https://www.natakainc.com/services/video-production-nairobi): brand films, commercials, corporate video, events, social content.
- [Music Video Production in Nairobi](https://www.natakainc.com/services/music-video-production-nairobi)
- [VFX & AI Video Editing](https://www.natakainc.com/services/vfx-ai-video-editing): compositing, motion graphics, colour grading, remote post-production.
- [Automotive Marketing in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/automotive-marketing-kenya)
- [Event Video Production in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/event-video-production-kenya)
- [Digital Marketing in Nairobi](https://www.natakainc.com/services/digital-marketing-nairobi)
- [Brand Strategy in Kenya](https://www.natakainc.com/services/brand-strategy-kenya)
